title: vitaldb-bench: timing and data-quality audit of VitalDB
description: Timing and data-quality audit of VitalDB: device clock drift and synchronisation, the delay and averaging window of every numeric value, derived per-case labels, and the whole-release scans behind the VitalDB metrology atlas.

creators.name: Goodwin, Andrew J.
creators.affiliation: School of Biomedical Engineering, The University of Sydney
